pending_commit.commit_message: manifest: Pin GCC aosp to a particular commit. We don't want the GCC compiler in ChromeOS changing with every commit to the AOSP repository; we want the ability to validate changes to the compiler for ChromeOS first. This CL pins the GCC sources we pull from AOSP to the most recent validated version of the sources. BUG=chromium:608773 TEST='repo sync' works, fetches correct aosp GCC. cros-kernel2.eclass: detect and unset incompatible CC tc-export doesn't change environment variables when they are set already. When CC is customly defined, it is used to build both userland programs and the kernel. That is a problem if they need different compilers. For example, when CC is set to armv7a-cros-linux-gnueabi-gcc for userland programs, it will also be used to compile the 64-bit kernel, which requires aarch64-cros-linux-gnu-gcc. This patch unsets incompatible CC when necessary so that tc-export can set CC for kernel properly. TEST=built aarch64 kernel with profile llvm BUG=chromium:619947 Change-Id: I8e5c78fc41aa0d758416a0a60a5a06b848d460d4 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/352490 Commit-Ready: Luis Lozano <llozano@chromium.org> Tested-by: Ting-Yuan Huang <laszio@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Mike Frysinger <vapier@chromium.org>

[django-directives] Recycle daemons to save memory The WSGIDaemonProcess directive prevents mpm_prefork from recycling the memory that Django uses, as it is tied up in the daemon. We can prevent the autotest memory leak from biting us by setting maximum-requests, which will recycle each daemon process after it gets a certain number of web requests. BUG=chromium:508986 TEST=Ran in moblab - the daemon processes were recycled. common: don't install to /usr/share/{cups/drv,ppd} /usr/share/ppd is for storing a local PPD library. We don't want this, as we will provide PPDs through other means. /usr/share/cups/drv is for PPD compiler drivers, which help to generate PPDs on the fly. We're already stripping ppdc (and it's actually deprecated upstream), so these aren't useful. We'll probably also mask these for individual ebuilds, but it's nice to make sure things don't fall through the cracks. BUG=chromium:620384 TEST=build; see $subject directories missing / empty Change-Id: I8c7286345d9a72cd886e0bffc1a42719dd8a6db4 Signed-off-by: Brian Norris <briannorris@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/354520 Reviewed-by: Mike Frysinger <vapier@chromium.org>
